title: RTX 5090 power connectors melt when enabling DLSS 5
summary: Users report critical failures in the RTX 5090's 12VHPWR connector after enabling DLSS 5, reigniting concerns about power design.

title: Unofficial mod brings DLSS 5 and Frame Generation to RTX 20, 30, and 40 cards
summary: A modder manages to enable DLSS 5 and frame generation technologies on previous generations of NVIDIA GPUs, extending their useful life.

title: LG unveils Gram Book AI 2026 with Intel Wildcat Lake and 30-hour battery
summary: LG's new premium ultraportable integrates Intel Wildcat Lake processors and promises record-breaking battery life exceeding 30 hours.
